最近出现了一个答案：一个被力场包裹、闪烁着奇异光芒的球体，从深层核心的熔岩流中缓缓升起。 其最初用途与构造尚不明朗，但在极高温度下，它会持续滴落出活体金属。这一发现虽巧妙地解开了那桩考古谜团，却也让我们面临新的抉择——该如何处置它。
texts.en:
As the colony on [planet.GetName] grew, so too did evidence of an extinct civilization that made use of Living Metal, though there was no trace of where they acquired this material.

An answer has recently surfaced, in the form of a strange shimmering sphere encased in a force field which buoyed up from deep core magma flows. Its original purpose and construction are not immediately obvious, but it produces a steady drip of Living Metal when exposed to extremely high temperatures. While this handily solves that archaeological puzzle, we must now decide what to do with it.

label.en: Toss it back into the lava.
